offence_note: Trafficking and possession for purpose of trafficking cocaine
sentence_quote: The principles of sentencing can best be achieved by suspending sentence and ordering that you be placed on probation for three years.
note: Suspended sentence with probation despite cocaine trafficking; exceptional circumstances found.

offence_note: Sexual assault of cognitively impaired woman
sentence_quote: hereby order the following: • 90 days custody to be served intermittently;
note: Conditional sentence unavailable; intermittent custody plus 24 months probation.

offence_note: Supplying handgun to Hells Angels member; breach of prohibition order
sentence_quote: the sentence is varied to a total of 20 months in addition to the credit of 18 months for pre-trial custody.
note: Crown appeal; s. 117.01 sentence raised to 12 months consecutive; total 20 months plus 18 months credit.

offence_note: Welfare fraud, falsifying document, perjury, obtaining goods by false pretences
sentence_quote: we would delete the term of restitution in the probation order that forms part of the conditional discharge so that Ms. Dennis is bound by the term of restitution in the first probation order
note: Supplementary reasons only fixing duplicate restitution term; restitution amount not shown.

offence_note: Sexual assault of child in position of trust; unregistered restricted firearm
sentence_quote: For these reasons I am prepared to accept the joint recommendation.
note: Two years exclusive of about one month remand; firearm offence one year concurrent.

sentence_quote: we are satisfied that the sentence imposed by the trial judge is fit.
note: Endorsement gives neither offences nor sentence.

offence_note: Possession for trafficking heroin and fentanyl, three counts
sentence_quote: I sentence you to incarceration for two years less a day followed by two years of probation.
note: Offence predates fentanyl sentencing threshold; concurrent sentences on three counts.

sentence_quote: leave to appeal is granted, the actual sentence on each count is reduced to 27 months, three weeks after taking into account pre‑sentence credit of 20 months and one week.
note: Appeal only for enhanced 1.5:1 pre-sentence credit under Summers; four-year sentences concurrent.

offence_note: Sexual assault, choking to commit sexual assault, threats, recognizance breaches
sentence_quote: I sentence you in addition to the 10-and-a-half months already served to the following: 23 months for sexual assault, which is Count 2;
note: 23 months is additional to 10.5 months already served; sentences concurrent.

sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal and substitute a sentence of three years in place of the four years imposed by the sentencing judge.
note: Five-year driving prohibition left in place.

offence_note: Home invasion robberies, forcible entry, loaded firearm, cocaine possession
sentence_quote: we are of the view that a global sentence of seven years, before credit for pre-sentence custody, would be adequate.
note: Adult sentence reduced from nine to seven years; one-year youth sentence unchanged; surcharge set aside.
